recommendedTextbook.title: Islamic Religious Studies for Junior Secondary Schools Book 1
recommendedTextbook.author: M. A. Folorunsho, A. K. Makinde
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: The Revelation of the Holy Quran and Surah Al-Alaq
subtopics: The night of majesty (Laylatul Qadr) in the cave of Hira
The first five verses revealed through Angel Jibril: 'Iqra' (Read!)
Importance of knowledge, literacy, and learning in Islamic civilization
objectives: Recite the first 5 verses of Surah Al-Alaq with accurate Arabic pronunciation
Explain the historical circumstances surrounding the first revelation to Prophet Muhammad (SAW)
Highlight how the commandment 'Iqra' elevates education as an Islamic duty

topics.topic: The Five Pillars of Islam (Arkanul Islam)
subtopics: Overview of the 5 foundational pillars: Shahadah (Declaration of Faith), Salah (Prayer), Zakah (Charity), Sawm (Fasting), Hajj (Pilgrimage)
The Kalimatush-Shahadah: Meaning, significance, and sincere declaration
How the 5 pillars foster spiritual discipline, equality, and brotherhood among Muslims
objectives: Recite the Shahadah in Arabic and provide its complete English translation
List the five pillars of Islam in sequential order of statutory obligation
Explain how the pillars build a just, empathetic, and God-conscious society

topics.topic: Tawheed: The Oneness of Allah and Prohibition of Shirk
subtopics: Meaning of Tawheed (Islamic Monotheism): Tawheed ar-Rububiyyah, al-Uluhiyyah, and al-Asma was-Sifat
Surah Al-Ikhlas: Text, translation, and declaration of absolute divine unity
Prohibition of Shirk (associating partners with Allah): Major Shirk vs minor Shirk (Riya/showing off)
objectives: Explain the three dimensions of Tawheed with scriptural citations
Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas with proper Tajweed and state its core theological tenets
Identify real-life manifestations of Shirk and explain why it is the unpardonable sin in Islam

subtopics: Meaning of Taharah and the Islamic hadith: 'Cleanliness is half of faith'
Types of water permissible for purification (Mutlaq water: rain, river, sea, well)
Step-by-step practical performance of Wudu (ablution) and acts that nullify Wudu
objectives: State the conditions of water required for ritual purification
Demonstrate sequential steps of performing complete Wudu according to the Sunnah
List 5 physical occurrences that invalidate ritual ablution
